summary:
index.js

Commands:
  index.js cloud            CloudBase commands
  index.js open             Open IDE / IDE project
  index.js login            re-login IDE
  index.js islogin          #islogin-desc
  index.js preview          preview
  index.js auto-preview     Auto preview
  index.js upload           Upload mini program
  index.js build-npm        build NPM
  index.js auto             Enable automation
  index.js auto-replay      Enable automation
  index.js reset-fileutils  #reset-fileutils-desc
  index.js close            Close project
  index.js quit             Quit IDE
  index.js cache            clean cache
  index.js engine           engine
  index.js open-other       Open other project
  index.js build-ipa        generate ipa
  index.js build-apk        genreate apk

Project options:
  --project    project path
  --appid      miniprogram appid or 3rd platform appid. Ignored when --project
               is provided
  --ext-appid  miniprogram appid to be developed by 3rd platform. Ignored when
               --project is provided

Other global options:
  --port         Optional. IDE HTTP server port. If IDE hasn't been launched, it
                 will be launched and start HTTP server at <port>. If IDE has
                 launched with a HTTP server of different port, you must quit
                 IDE before re-run the command.                         [number]
  --lang         Optional. 'en' or 'zh'. Defaults to 'en'.
  --debug        Optional. Turn on debug mode
  --disable-gpu  Disable GPU Acceleration when launching IDE           [boolean]
  -h, --help     Show help                                             [boolean]
